node.statement: For the single witness choice fixed in 1.1, lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger and lem-maincb-witness-arithmetic give D_* >= 1, W.c0_cb=c0 >= max{c0^0,K_floor,C_unit*(K_floor+1)}, and W.r_reset = min{e_0,e_1,e_2,e_3,epsilon_max^cb,delta_max^cb/D_*,e_it/(D_*+1),epsilon_unit,delta_unit/max{1,K_floor},a_unit/((1+K_disp)*D_*),[2*(1+K_disp)*D_*]^{-1}}. Thus W.r_reset is at most every reset threshold required by lem-maincb-reset-output-typing for D=D_*. In addition, lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger gives, from 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN, the global scalar-scale bound epsilon <= W.r_reset. All occurrences of C_unit,epsilon_unit,delta_unit,a_unit here are the one tuple fixed in 1.1, not a second existential choice.
